Street Fighter 6 - Arjun Gameplay Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/street-fighter-6/

Like an aggressive bull jumping in the dust of the fields, Arjun moves heaven and earth with his powerful breathing techniques!

Beware of his brutal blows, or he'll have you gasping for air.

Arjun can be purchased individually with Fighter Coins, and the owners of the Year 4 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass will automatically get access to him when he releases on October 13.

Okko The Exiled - Gameplay Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
Get ready to embark on an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch, deflect and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens! After 1,000 years of concealment, Okko is ready to wield the Mighty Fang and take down Kutala’s lords one by one. Defeat powerful foes, overcome obstacles and unleash your heart as Okko fights to fulfill an ancient oath. Enjoy meticulously hand-drawn 2D animations that bring Kutala’s characters to life in retro-inspired pixel art glory!

Okko The Exiled is coming to PS5® and PS4® in early 2027. Wishlist now!
